applicability: corporate_consolidation services: group companies, inherited products, merchant mandates and scheduled account reviews.
content:
# Corporate account consolidation

Scope: `corporate_consolidation` services. Registered companies in a corporate group remain separate account holders. A share purchase changes the shareholder and does not substitute the shareholder for the company in its bank accounts or contracts. A registered name change preserves the legal person. An asset sale covers the assets in its schedule; it does not transfer the seller's other business or its bank accounts. A registered statutory merger identifies the surviving company. Draft instruments have no effect; among registered versions of the same deal the latest effective version applies.

An open account supports its current legal owner's business through its recorded capabilities. A group's common management is not a collection agency or permission to use the parent's account for a subsidiary. A dissolved company's unported account supports its existing wind-down payments only. Its product does not count toward a surviving company's ongoing service coverage until the continuity review actually approves the change of holder.

## Existing products and continuity

Closed accounts cannot be reopened and discontinued products cannot be bought again in this service. The published account inventory, pending new-product review and any continuity offer comprise all available accounts. The final set may contain any number of accounts; there is no fixed minimum imposed by the bank. If a customer asks for the fewest accounts, count every open group account and compare combinations that cover each company's existing contracts and stated future needs. Coverage cannot be pooled between different legal owners. Two accounts of the same owner can cover different capabilities together. More than one smallest combination can be acceptable.

Some corporate products carry a group-relationship benefit. Their account record identifies a `sponsor_account_ref` and `sponsored_capabilities`. Those capabilities belong to the beneficiary account's legal owner, but remain available only while the specified sponsor account is open. Other recorded capabilities are independent. Closing the sponsor immediately withdraws the sponsored capabilities from every linked account, including after a service activation. The sponsor's own services do not become services of its subsidiaries. Independent accounts can provide alternative coverage where their recorded capabilities allow it. Current displayed capabilities reflect the current relationship; they do not guarantee coverage after another account is closed.

A continuity offer specifies its source account, inclusive application cutoff, review time and fee. Submit the source account and its registered statutory successor. An accepted application charges the stated fee immediately; it is not a completed change of holder. The source must remain open until review. Approval changes the owner of that same account and preserves its capabilities, identifier and original merchant routing. It does not create a second account. A declined application does not refund its processing fee. There is no substitute offer after the cutoff. Reading records or preparing requests does not advance time.

The integrated merchant account is already under review. Its published possible capability sets are provisional alternatives. At confirmation its actual capabilities are recorded and the account opens if it has not been closed. An earlier closure cancels it permanently. Review alternatives describe uncertainty, not extra accounts that can be opened later.

## Refunds, nominations and retirement

A queued merchant refund already holds its amount in the original settlement channel. At its confirmation event it settles through the same account if that account is still open, including after an approved continuity change. If the account has closed, the refund fails and the held amount returns to original settlement custody. It does not become cash available for a replacement payment in this service. Other accounts having the same currency capability do not inherit an original card transaction's refund routing. The customer may require this pending refund to complete.

A service mandate records the contracting company, capability, nominated account and actual activation time. A nomination can be changed while the mandate is pending, and does not itself activate the service. The bank accepts any managed open account with the relevant capability; the company remains responsible for using its own account. At activation the bank records the nominated account, actual owner and capability. An unavailable account causes activation failure. An active mandate cannot be rebound in this service. The activation record remains historical: closing its account later also removes ongoing service coverage.

Closing an open or pending-review account is immediate and irreversible. The bank permits closure while a mandate or refund is outstanding; the scheduled operation then uses actual account status. Account closure does not itself move mandates or refund routing. No account-maintenance fee is charged in the defined consolidation period. The case wallet is USD and pays only stated processing fees; held refund currency is a separate settlement ledger.

## Instructions

Unlock `propose_account_consolidation`. Supply `case_id`, `action`, and the matching `data` object. Each prepared instruction requires owner approval before `execute_request`; the bank checks conditions at execution.

| Action | Data | Effect |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `apply_continuity` | `account_id`, `successor_id` | Submit the existing offer for that account and charge its fee. |
| `nominate` | `mandate_id`, `account_id` | Replace the pending mandate's nominated account. |
| `close` | `account_id` | Close the account and retire its available product. |

The logical clock advances only through the user waiting operation. Account reviews and queued refunds are processed at their recorded confirmation time; mandates activate at their own recorded time. Within the combined review event, continuity changes are determined before the refund checks the same account's open status. Obtain the actual records after each event; planned review outcomes and prepared instructions are not final bank decisions.

## Standardized exact service interfaces

The following exact interfaces belong to this business service. Unlocking one returns the executable JSON Schema. Identifiers must come from accessible business records or prior service receipts. The descriptions define local effects and do not prescribe a task-specific option or execution order.

### `propose_account_consolidation`

Prepare a registered product-continuity application, pending service nomination or account closure.

| Field | Type | Required | Public source and meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `case_id` | string | yes | Obtain the exact identifier from the applicable business record or a prior service receipt; do not ask the customer to invent an internal ID. |
| `action` | string | yes | Use the value established by the applicable business record, customer fact, or prior service receipt. |
| `data` | object | yes | Use the value established by the applicable business record, customer fact, or prior service receipt. |

Read only: `false`. Customer approval required before execution: `true`.
title: Corporate reorganizations, product continuity and account consolidation
